user.title: Add a Neo Smart Blinds controller
user.description: Blinds are added after this, from the controller's entry: choose Add blind.

data_description.host: The controller's IP address. In the Neo app open the menu, choose Your Controllers, and read the IP line under the controller. Give it a fixed address in your router so it doesn't change.
data_description.protocol: HTTP is recommended: the controller reports a wrong controller ID or a bad command. TCP only echoes the command back.

data_description.port: Filled in with the default for {protocol}. Only change it if your controller uses a different port.
data_description.hub_id: In the Neo app open the menu, choose Your Controllers, and copy the long ID (about 24 characters) under the controller's name. Required for HTTP, not used by TCP.

abort.blind_imported: The blind was added to an existing controller.
abort.invalid_protocol: Protocol must be http or tcp.
abort.invalid_blind_code: The blind code must use the format 000.000-00.
abort.invalid_parent_group: The room code must use the format 000.000-15.

data_description.name: How the blind is named in Home Assistant, for example Kitchen left.
data_description.blind_code: In the Neo app open the blind, tap the settings (advanced) page and read Blind Code, for example 021.230-04. To control a whole room as one cover, use the Room Code (it ends in -15) instead.
data_description.motor_code: Shown as Motor code under the Blind Code on the same page of the Neo app. Pick it from the list, or type it if it's missing. Some controllers (such as the C-BR300) need it.
data_description.rail: For top-down/bottom-up blinds (the Neo app shows Top-D/Bottom-U: YES). Ordinary blinds use the top rail.
data_description.tdbu_extended: Only for top-down/bottom-up blinds whose motor code is mb, ra, ap or db. Leave off for tb motors and ordinary blinds.
data_description.tilt: Turn on for blinds whose slats tilt. Adds tilt open and close controls (the side arrows), which send the motor small micro-steps. Leave off for roller blinds. Some motors, such as Wistar/Alpha (wt), ignore micro-steps.
data_description.percent_support: The controller never reports where a blind is, so Home Assistant estimates it from the open and close times. Choose "Blind moves to the position" only if the % position switch works for this blind in the Neo app. Both position options show a position slider; "Open and close only" shows up, stop and down buttons.
data_description.close_time: Seconds the blind takes to go from fully open to fully closed. Not shown in the Neo app. Once the blind is added, open its settings and choose Measure open and close times to time it for you, or use a stopwatch.
data_description.open_time: Optional. Seconds the blind takes to go from fully closed to fully open, if that differs from the close time (blinds often rise slower). Leave empty to use the close time.
data_description.startup_sync: Home Assistant can't ask the controller where a blind is, so the estimate drifts when someone uses the remote or the Neo app. Choose open or close to move the blind fully that way whenever Home Assistant starts, so the position is known again. Updates and restarts will move the blind.
data_description.start_position: Optional. The position (0 closed, 100 open) to assume the first time, before Home Assistant has saved one. Only used with a position option. After that the last known position is always restored.
data_description.parent_group: Optional. The Room Code from the blind's settings page in the Neo app (ends in -15). When every blind with the same room code gets the same command within 250 ms, one room command is sent instead.

calibrate.title: Measure travel times
calibrate.description:
This times {name} closing and opening, so Home Assistant can estimate its position accurately. You'll need to see the blind.

First it opens fully. Press Submit to open it now.

calibrate_close.title: Measure the close time
calibrate_close.description: Wait until {name} has stopped at the top. Then press Submit to start closing it, and watch it.

calibrate_closed.title: Closing…
calibrate_closed.description: Press Submit the moment {name} stops at the bottom.

calibrate_open.title: Measure the open time
calibrate_open.description: {name} is closed. Press Submit to start opening it, and watch it.

calibrate_opened.title: Opening…
calibrate_opened.description: Press Submit the moment {name} stops at the top.

calibrate_save.title: Save the times?
calibrate_save.description:
Measured for {name}:

- Close time: {close_time} s
- Open time: {open_time} s

Press Submit to save them. To measure again, close this and start over.

error.invalid_motor_code: Motor codes are two letters or digits, for example bf.
error.tdbu_extended_motor: The extended command set only applies to motor codes mb, ra, ap and db.
error.parent_is_blind: The room code must differ from the blind code.
error.position_not_supported: "Blind moves to the position" needs the top rail, the standard command set and a motor code of no, db, ra, rb, ap, bl, mb or jo. Use "Timed position (estimated)" instead.
error.already_configured: This blind and rail are already set up on this controller.
error.cannot_send: Couldn't send the command to the controller. Check that it's online and try again.

abort.not_loaded: The controller isn't loaded. Check its connection, then try again.
abort.cover_unavailable: This blind's cover entity isn't available (it may be disabled). Enable it, then try again.

options.0: Open and close only: up, stop and down buttons, no position
options.1: Blind moves to the position: Home Assistant sends the % to the motor
options.2: Timed position (estimated): moves up or down, then stops after the calculated time

invalid_hub_id.message: The controller rejected the controller ID. Re-authenticate the integration with the correct ID.

yaml_import_failed.title: Neo Smart Blinds YAML blind could not be imported
yaml_import_failed.description: The blind {name} in configuration.yaml could not be imported ({reason}). Fix it in YAML and restart, or add it from the UI, then remove the YAML entry.

init.title: Room names
init.description:
Each room code shared by two or more blinds gets a room cover that moves them all together. Give each room a name (leave empty for "Room" and the code).

{rooms}

abort.no_rooms: No room covers yet. Give two or more blinds the same room code (in each blind's settings) and a room cover is created for them.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Sends a raw Neo action to a blind, or to a whole room through its room cover. Use at your own risk: commands may do nothing on your motor, and some are programming commands that can change the blind's settings (limits, direction, favorites or pairing), which may leave it unusable until your installer sets it up again. Home Assistant's position estimate isn't changed.

command.name: Command
command.description: Two letters or digits from the Neo protocol, for example mu or md (micro-step), i1 or i2 (intermediate positions on NEO motors), u4 or d4 (middle rail on extended top-down/bottom-up blinds), or 01-99 (go to a position on motors that support it). Only send commands you know your motor supports. The blind's motor code is added automatically.
